description: An S-3 operations officer must assign personnel to the Partner Liaison Cell and Movement Control Cell for Tuesday's regional interoperability exercise and record the coordination actions needed to make both assignments executable.

shared_context.S1: Tuesday's regional interoperability exercise requires one person in the Partner Liaison Cell and one person in the Movement Control Cell.
shared_context.S2: Both cells operate from 0800 to 1600 Tuesday at the Support Operations Center.
shared_context.S3: The current available-personnel roster lists Sgt. Vale, Sgt. Malik, and Cpl. Ortiz for these assignments.
shared_context.S4: Maj. Alvarez signs the final exercise support assignment.
shared_context.S5: At the routine exercise-planning huddle, Maj. Alvarez confirms qualification and readiness updates with the training and personnel staff before publishing the assignment.
shared_context.S6: The Partner Liaison Cell conducts the 0800 partner-briefing check-in, while the Movement Control Cell must have its control-system access confirmed before 0730.

PF1.text: SFC Brooks confirmed this morning that Sgt. Vale is the only person on the roster with a current partner-language liaison certification, but the certification update has not yet been entered on the exercise briefing slide.

PF2.text: Lt. Shah confirmed during yesterday's personnel audit that Cpl. Ortiz is the only person on the roster with a current Movement Control System operator qualification; the qualification record is still awaiting posting to the personnel tracker.

acceptance_conditions: Sgt. Vale must be assigned to the Partner Liaison Cell.
Cpl. Ortiz must be assigned to the Movement Control Cell.
The Partner Liaison Cell check-in must be set for 0800 Tuesday.
Movement Control System access must be confirmed by 0730 Tuesday.
The qualification records must be updated before the exercise.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] in ['qualification_verification', 'record_update', 'briefing_slide_update', 'personnel_tracker_update', 'documentation_update'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Sgt. Vale's current partner-language liaison certification changes the Partner Liaison Cell assignment from an otherwise arbitrary roster choice to Sgt. Vale.
Cpl. Ortiz's current Movement Control System qualification changes the Movement Control Cell assignment from an otherwise arbitrary roster choice to Cpl. Ortiz.
